Definition: from G2316 and G1321; divinely instructed:--taught of God.
BiblicalUsage: The word theodídaktos carries the sense of taught of God. In 1 Thessalonians 4:9, ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that being taught by God is not a privilege for the few; it is the promise to all who belong to Him.
